description: Freedom Fighter mounted in the centre of an elliptical landscaped basin at the Aksaray road grade-separated interchange in Selçuklu. Serial 3016 is also its construction number. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves the aircraft mounted at the centre of the ellipse; this is one of the most striking monument settings in Turkey.
museum_name: Aksaray Yolu Interchange NF-5 Monument -- Konya
